zh.title: 豪雨引發枋山枋野土石流加劇 台鐵南迴線8月25日深夜前全線停駛
zh.summary: 豪雨致枋山至枋野土石流加劇；台鐵南迴線於8月25日24時前全線停駛。
body: 根據報導，受豪雨影響，臺灣鐵路位於枋山與枋野路段之間的土石流狀況呈現加劇趨勢。強烈降雨致使該區域鐵路線路周邊土石流現象持續發展。
因應枋山至枋野區間土石流加劇情況，臺灣鐵路管理局針對南迴線採取預警與應變措施。台鐵宣布南迴線全線列車於2026年8月25日晚間24時前實施全面停駛。
本次停駛範圍涵蓋台鐵南迴線整體路線，所有列車服務於2026年8月25日24時前暫停營運。相關單位持續關注該路段豪雨與土石流之最新變化。

en.title: Heavy Rain Worsens Mudslides as TRA Suspends South-Link Line Service
en.summary: Taiwan Railways suspended South-Link Line services before midnight on August 25 following heavy rain and mudslides.
body: Heavy rain has intensified mudslides along the railway section between Fangshan and Fangye in Taiwan. Severe rainfall in the region has worsened mudslide activity along the corridor, affecting the local railway infrastructure.

In response to the intensifying mudslide conditions between Fangshan and Fangye, Taiwan Railways announced a complete suspension of train operations on the South-Link Line. All train services on the South-Link Line are halted prior to midnight (24:00) on August 25, 2026.

The full operational suspension applies across the entire South-Link Line route until midnight on August 25. Rail authorities continue to monitor weather conditions and mudslide development in the affected sector.
